LeftBlank · 留白
English中文

Privacy, with room to write.

Effective October 2, 2026. This policy covers LeftBlank for Mac and leftblank.app, published by Fenjin Wang.

Your documents

LeftBlank edits and typesets documents locally on your Mac. We do not collect your manuscripts, exports or editing history, and do not operate a server that receives them. There is no advertising or analytics SDK in the app. You do not need a LeftBlank account.

Network requests and optional services

When you browse the Typst package catalog, download packages, templates or sample books, LeftBlank contacts the relevant catalog or download host. Those providers receive the network information necessary to serve the request, such as your IP address. Opening a document that requires an unbundled package can trigger a package download; it does not upload your document to us. Third-party services have their own privacy policies.

If you use an iCloud-enabled build and turn on iCloud, document synchronization is handled by Apple through your Apple Account. We cannot access your iCloud documents. The independently distributed Preview can check for updates and download releases; the App Store build does not include that updater.

This website

The website uses no analytics, advertising trackers or third-party fonts. Language and appearance choices are stored only in your browser. The hosting provider processes network requests to deliver the site. Downloading examples does not require an account.

Support and your choices

You can delete your local files and browser preferences yourself and manage iCloud data through Apple. If you choose to contact support or submit a public GitHub issue, the content you provide will be used to handle your request. Avoid including private manuscripts in public issues. For support or a privacy question, contact wangfenj@gmail.com or visit LeftBlank support.

为写作，也为隐私留白。

生效日期：2026 年 10 月 2 日。本政策适用于 Fenjin Wang 发布的 Mac 应用留白（LeftBlank）及 leftblank.app。

你的文稿

留白在你的 Mac 上本地编辑与排版。我们不收集文稿、导出文件或编辑历史，也没有接收这些内容的文稿服务器。应用不包含广告或统计分析 SDK，不需要注册留白账号。

网络请求与可选服务

浏览 Typst 包目录、下载包、模板或示例书籍时，应用会访问相关目录或下载服务。服务商会接收完成请求所需的网络信息，例如 IP 地址。打开使用未内置包的文稿可能触发包下载，但不会把文稿上传给我们。第三方服务适用各自的隐私政策。

使用支持 iCloud 的版本并开启 iCloud 时，文稿同步由 Apple 通过你的 Apple 账号处理，我们无法访问你的 iCloud 文稿。独立分发的预览版可以检查更新并下载新版本；App Store 版本不包含该更新器。

本网站

本网站不使用统计分析、广告追踪或第三方字体。语言与外观偏好只保存在你的浏览器中。托管服务商处理提供网页所需的网络请求。下载示例无需账号。

帮助与你的选择

你可以自行删除本地文件和浏览器偏好，并通过 Apple 管理 iCloud 数据。主动联系支持或提交公开 GitHub issue 时，你提供的内容将用于处理请求。请勿在公开 issue 中附上私人文稿。帮助或隐私问题可联系 wangfenj@gmail.com，或访问留白帮助与反馈。
